Title: AI Security Engineer

API & Backend Specialist: You have proven experience designing robust, scalable microservices capable of handling strict latency and reliability constraints. Analytical Problem-Solver: You can effectively balance the trade-offs between rigorous security, high system performance, and a positive user experience. Growth Mindset: You enjoy staying up-to-date with secure AI frameworks (such as ISO/IEC 42001 or OWASP) and exploring advanced methods like time-series anomaly detection and graph analysis. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred). 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a heavy focus on backend architecture, API design, and distributed systems. 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, fraud detection, trust & safety, or abuse prevention. 2+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment. At arrivia , we Stay Curious, Keep it Real, and Win Together. We offer a collaborative, inclusive environment where your work directly impacts how millions of people experience the world. Apply today and help us take charge of change.
